meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上 hyperplan 后，Claude 会当总协调：先召来 5 个互相对立的智能体交叉批判，只留下站得住的结论，再强制交给专门的 plan 智能体写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”等触发词，或需要高严谨性、暴露薄弱假设/盲点/过度设计时触发。它也要求主会话、团队工具、以 sisyphus 等有资格角色运行，否则停下。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 做发布计划，重点暴露薄弱假设和盲点。
say.note: 会先回复 HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!

say.text: hpp 跑一遍 7 阶段对抗评审，最后强制交给 plan 智能体。
say.note: 成员互相攻击结论，站不住的会被淘汰。

say.text: /hyperplan 做一份经得起质疑的迁移方案，重点查过度设计。
say.note: 缺主会话或团队工具时会停下并给配置方法。

howto.what_en: Hyperplan makes Claude a planning lead: it spawns 5 hostile members who cross-critique each other, keeps only insights that survive, then mandates handing them to the plan agent to write the executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'hyperplan', 'hpp' etc., or when planning needs max rigor and surfacing weak assumptions, blind spots, over-engineering. Needs team tools, main session, running as sisyphus or another lead.

say_en.text: Run hyperplan to make a release plan and surface weak assumptions and blind spots.
say_en.note: It replies 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!' and starts the team.

say_en.text: Use hpp to run a 7-phase adversarial review, then hand off to plan.
say_en.note: Members cross-attack; survivors shape the final plan.

say_en.text: Make an attack-resistant migration plan with hyperplan.
say_en.note: When prerequisites are missing, it stops and explains setup.
